bluf: Phiture is a Berlin mobile growth consultancy and agency, founded 2016, selling app store optimisation, Apple Search Ads, performance marketing, retention CRM and data work to app teams, wrapped in frameworks (Mobile Growth Stack, ASO Stack) and tools (Catchbase, PressPlay, B.Layer). The record lists no news, no jobs and no pricing, its own site carries no testing tool while it sells CRO, and a blog slug of 24 February 2026 says Precis and Phiture join forces with nothing else in the record explaining it. A rival should know the movable hours are ASO and Apple Ads, and the tools are the moat.
doing:
The positioning line, an award winning mobile growth consultancy and agency that upskills app teams or runs their growth, built on its Mobile Growth Stack framework, decodes to two modes of sale: train the client's team or do the work. The headline claim is 500+ experiments weekly, 10+ published industry frameworks and 900K article reads; behind it sit the ASO Stack and Mobile Growth Stack Slack communities and newsletters.

The sold mix, breadth 8, is six core lines. SEO leads at score 3 as app store search: ASO heads the service list, with the Headspace and Deezer ASO cases. Five lines score 2: CRO (A/B tests lifted installs 20% for Lion Studios and CVR 57% for Avakin Life), Data & Measurement (a Data, Tech & AI service, attribution and MMP integration, Firebase tracking fixed for Picsart), Email & CRM (Braze automation for HBO Max EMEA and foodspring), Paid Search scored as Apple Search Ads (the Catchbase tool; Yotta, Invoice Simple, Planta and onX cases) and Paid Social (Klimaneustart Meta ads, EasyPark, The Chefz). No partners are listed; Catchbase's ownership is not stated, and the Pinger slug earlier named it ASAI.

AI posture: Phiture AI Labs (a ChatGPT plugin for ASO keyword data, ASO Monthly #88, year not shown), the Data, Tech & AI service and PressPlay automated testing with GenAI; the Horus read marks P4 making and P1 and P6 partial.

Moves: founded in Berlin in 2016 by Andy Carvell and Moritz Daan; no news and no jobs are listed. Dated case pages run from the 2020 Headspace and Deezer cases to HBO Max EMEA (27 May 2026). Blog slugs dated 24 February 2026 (Precis and Phiture join forces), 20 August 2026 and 10 September 2026 (Apple's new App Store terms, the EU Digital Services Act) show policy tracking.

Pricing: no signal. Conspicuously absent: an employee count, a described Precis relationship, an audited AI visibility product.
clients:
Client type: mixed, consumer mobile apps across health and wellness, education, streaming and entertainment, creative tools and fintech; home market Berlin, with cases in Saudi Arabia (The Chefz) and Hong Kong (Taobao) and a Spanish meditation app (Pura Mente).

The needs read lists 27 client rows: 16 observed and 11 names only. Paid performance sits on 6 rows, CRM on 4, web, organic and brand on 3 each. Observed signals: HBO Max EMEA, CRM, Braze automation dated 27 May 2026 claiming 40% higher open rates; Blinkist, web plus CRM, dated 13 May 2024, claiming 51% higher renewal likelihood; Yotta, paid plus AI, Catchbase automation of Apple Ads dated 25 November 2025; Picsart, paid plus brand, dated 9 May 2025, day 7 ROAS above 35%; Headspace, organic, ASO dated 19 October 2020, users from 6 to 6.6 million; Wildlife Studios, AI, PressPlay testing dated 12 March 2024, 12M projected installs; The Chefz, paid, dated 7 May 2024, purchases up 609%; Pinger and Invoice Simple, organic plus paid, Apple Search Ads slugs; Klimaneustart, paid, a Meta ads slug; foodspring and Fishbrain, CRM slugs; Lion Studios (AppLovin), data, an A/B testing slug. The 11 names only rows are Clue, Deezer, Planta, Sololearn, Once Upon, Hallow, Lifesum, SoundCloud, Burner, Taobao and Avakin Life, needs inferred from the sold mix, although the Deezer and Taobao titles name ASO work and the Avakin Life slug a CVR increase from PressPlay.

Two clients sit on other tracked books: HBO Max EMEA (razorfish, media-monks) and Deezer (artefact). Next: under KJ5 (The price of attention splits in two) it is likely, moderate confidence, that these app teams push retention and incrementality over acquisition, which its CRM and measurement lines sell; under KJ6 (The agency middle is being hollowed out) a roughly even chance the ASO retainers are cut first.

openings:
Lead with the observed contradiction: it sells CRO on 500+ experiments weekly and its own homepage runs no testing tool. The strongest judgment is price: displacement 58.8 on the Monsoon read, movable hours in ASO and Apple Search Ads, and no public pricing make it likely, moderate confidence, that an offshore delivered ASO and Apple Ads rival undercuts the retainers line by line with a transparent outcome priced offer it cannot match in public. Falsifier: a published pricing model, or a tool licence offer that decouples Catchbase and PressPlay from agency hours.

Second, the tools: Catchbase's ownership is not stated and the Pinger slug named it ASAI, so a buyer asking who owns the bid models gets no answer; roughly even chance that matters, low confidence. Third, P8 and P2 absent: the first app agency to show results from ads inside assistants sets the price against its Apple Ads line. Fourth, the shoppers: HBO Max EMEA sits on razorfish and media-monks and Deezer on artefact, so both are likely contestable. Hard to beat: the case figures, the ASO community and P4 making; almost no chance a rival out publishes it on ASO.
